purpose: Form NCLT-14 is used to record the certification by an attester when an affidavit is sworn or affirmed by an illiterate, visually challenged, or language-unacquainted person.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Ensure the affidavit is read, explained, or translated to the deponent.
Verify that the deponent seems to understand the affidavit.
Have the deponent make his signature or mark in the presence of the attester.
Execute the attester certificate in Form NCLT-14.
checklist: Affidavit for an illiterate, visually challenged, or language-unacquainted deponent
Attester ready to certify that the affidavit was read, explained, or translated
watch: Make sure the deponent makes his signature or mark in the presence of the attester.
